integrity: All statements are supported by an explicit signed-degree proof and reproducible finite checks. No originality claim is made for the efficient domination notion or prior colouring bounds.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple cubic graphs only; no upper bound on the exact index when it is greater than two, and order divisibility conditions are necessary only. Publication-priority uncertainty remains; no independent audit.
title: Two-colour strong-majority edge colourings of connected cubic graphs and efficient domination
